card.name: Accommodations and disability justification wording
card.fires_on: Words inside lists of school or work accommodations for a medical condition, and commas or linking words in statements about whether someone is disabled or needs allowances. Fires on words like Allow, extra time, breaks, and 'indeed,' before disabled.
